issues.description: Test file moduledoc/spec require an isolated MIX_TEST_PARTITION because shared letflow_test can hold stale tenant_template_build_* registrations that make delete/1 raise 42P01; the test does not isolate itself from that. This is documented, and is an environment property of delete/1 iterating every registration (pre-existing design), not a test defect. CI uses a clean DB.
AC-14 test re-registers the entry in the loop after each terminal-status success; cleanup relies on the on_exit registered by register!/0 which covers the same service_id, so it is sound.
